svg.aria-label: The Dropbox folder holds table.json, host.json, the recent and daily copies, the assets by hash, and the clock file, each with what it carries.

g.text: table_id, name, the version every host must run (exact match), the On Air token and address,
a counter for each key change and each token change. Any key holder can write it: a convention, not a wall.
who hosts: launcher id and name, epoch and seq, since when, the address, a heartbeat, released or not,
and a hand-over request when one is pending. Written with compare-and-swap on its revision.
save-e<epoch>-s<seq>.zip: the database with a manifest. Uploaded when the game changed,
at most every 3 minutes, once more at Stop and at a hand-over. The last five are kept.
save-<date>.zip: the first copy of each day, thirty days kept.
The daily copies survive a bad evening: the pull takes the newest usable, recent first.
one file per image, named by its sha256: the map, portraits, tokens. Uploaded once each,
pulled only when a copy's manifest names one this PC lacks.
a few random bytes, rewritten to read the server's time off it when an answer carries no Date header.
Dropbox keeps identical uploads as one revision, so the bytes must change every time.
